title: Expired pending-begin repair: Resume precondition parity and remaining test gaps
outcome: The Resume override for an expired, never-sent pending begin states or matches the preconditions of the other Releasable arms. Tests cover the gaps the review named.
acceptance: Resume releases an expired, never-sent pending begin afresh only when the head's promotion disposition is known and Engram control is enabled for the session; with control disabled, Resume behaves as it did before the expiry change (the ordinary Resume, not a 409); tests cover a control-disabled head and an interrupted (parked) head whose pending grant expired.

engram_prepared_begin_grant_expired_at has a table test: an expiry equal to now is expired, a non-UTC offset is compared as the same instant, a nanosecond-precision RFC 3339 string parses, and an unparsable or absent expiry is never expired; and EngramIssuedTurnGrant reads expires_at from a full Engram TurnGrantBasis-shaped payload.

docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md describes issued_no_later_than as issuance evidence, states that expiry is judged only by grant_expires_at, and records that the expiry withdrawal reuses the begin_preparation_unacknowledged card code on purpose, because Resume's Releasable classification keys on it.
Focused tests covering the change and its new tests pass in the item's named worktree, and the full gate is green on the frozen input.
The review pair (Codex and Claude, read-only) has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding on the frozen input.
